title: Effects of tapering on performance: a meta-analysis
claims: Twenty-seven of 182 potential studies met the inclusion criteria for this meta-analysis of taper effects on performance in competitive athletes.
The optimal strategy was a tapering intervention of 2-week duration (overall effect 0.59 ± 0.33, P < 0.001).
Training volume was exponentially decreased by 41%–60% (overall effect 0.72 ± 0.36, P < 0.001).
Performance gains were obtained without any modification of training intensity (overall effect 0.33 ± 0.14) or training frequency (overall effect 0.35 ± 0.17).
The authors concluded that a 2-week taper with a 41%–60% exponential reduction in training volume is the most efficient strategy for maximizing performance gains.
